async def act(page):
    # Click the Order Count link under the Reports menu to navigate to the order count report
    # Use a precise selector based on the accessibility tree hierarchy
    reports_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="\ue80a Reports")
    # Get the menu under Reports and filter to find the specific menu containing 'Order Count'
    # From the tree: menubar > link 'Reports' > menu > menu > menu > link 'Order Count'
    order_count_link = reports_link.get_by_role("menu").filter(
        has=page.get_by_role("menu").filter(
            has=page.get_by_role("menu").filter(
                has=page.get_by_role("link", name="Order Count")
            )
        )
    ).get_by_role("link", name="Order Count")
    await order_count_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    return
